notes.title: HOTFIX 3
notes.notes:
Fixed a Unity compatibility bug that would prevent achievements from ever unlocking.
 Fixed some dodgy collisions in the father-side invisible path area.
 Adjusted movement speed in the Prologue and Chapter 1 openings, to be in line with the rest of the game.

notes.title: HOTFIX 2
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that would result in some options to be applied multiple times in a row.
This should fix some issues with setting volume, brightness and mouse sensitivity correctly.

notes.title: HOTFIX 1
notes.notes:
Just a small update to mainly address the boss fight being too long/difficult/annoying.

To those who left a negative review mostly because of the boss fight, please consider giving it a shot again and see if it improves your opinion of the game overall.


 Valves in the boss room now descend/ascend more quickly
 The boss has now only one phase, once you hit it it's gone!
 Fixed a bug that resulted in some players getting stuck when interacting with the mirror in the blue room.


I'm still working on fixing achievements not properly unlocking, please bear with me.

notes.title: IMPORTANT NEWS AND RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hello, Poopsy here!

First off, thank you so much for sticking around! It’s been two challenging years since I started working on
The Lies We Tell Ourselves and I’ve finally reached a point in which I'm able to share some important news.

The past year and a half has been significantly difficult for me: starting from the aftermath of losing my father, to serious health concerns which forced me in the hospital for quite some time, to eventually two delicate surgeries... the development of the game suffered terribly.

As a solo developer, I had to weigh my options and choose what's the best for the game and for me.
I didn't want to delay it again, nor did I want to cut stuff out of it and ruin pace and narrative just to fit
a deadline.

So, after a lot of thought, I’ve decided to release the game in an episodic format.

Moving to an episodic release feels like the best way to bring this story to you sooner, while still ensuring
the whole experience gets the care and polish it deserves, even if it means taking things one step at a time.

The first episode will be available on January 15 2025 at $7.99, reflecting what I believe to be an honest and accessible price to begin the experience.

Each episode will deliver around 2 hours worth of narrative, puzzles, introspection, dread, plus a final boss fight, all building on the main story arc and giving you a chance to experience the world of The Lies We Tell Ourselves as it unfolds.


Thank you again for your understanding and for being here with me.

notes.title: UPDATE ON THE GAME DEVELOPMENT
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/a421ea7e9cbca831bfc688aea73e8588ce261fde.png
Hello, Poopsy here!
As some of you might know, The Lies We Tell Ourselves was originally planned for a Q4 2023 release.

Unfortunately, the last 6 months have been pretty difficult, in terms of personal health and unexpected family loss.
As a result, I've been struggling to find the necessary peace of mind to focus on developing the game, on top of the usual struggle in trying to promote it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/1f78d5495ba69563a0b8d9f1790ebc2aa9a550d9.jpg
Thankfully, things are getting progressively better and I'm steadly getting back on track with my development schedule.
However, I will have to make up for the time lost, which means I had to make the tough decision to delay the launch.

Additionally, I only get to release once and -as a solo dev- I'm simply too small and invisible to even attempt to compete against any of the amazing titles, big and small, that have been and will be released by the end of this year.

For the sake of clarity, I'm aiming for a Q2 or Q3 2024 release. I will share an actual date as I get closer to my deadline and assess the situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/4957a4d040dce6ffc7b5131cabc655506dbb65bd.png
I deeply appreciate any support during this time. Whether it's leaving a cute comment, tagging your favorite content creator to play the demo or simply helping spread the word, your involvement and understanding mean more than words can express.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/b63f9d0ace1b169e318a1b9db0cfecebff43b030.png
Take care!
